title: REL-A.I.: An Interaction-Centered Approach To Measuring Human-LM Reliance
reasoning: The paper introduces the REL-A.I. evaluation framework which benchmarks human reliance on LLM outputs across multiple domains, specifically including 'philosophy' and 'world religion'. It evaluates these using questions from the MMLU dataset related to moral philosophy (e.g., moral verdicts) and religious traditions (e.g., Jaina traditions) to see how subject matter affects human interactional behavior.
